summary: Full end-to-end testing of Blog CMS (MongoDB + Quill WYSIWYG + S3 image upload) and Admin Gallery Manager for Life at Sgital. 18 backend pytest cases covering public blog APIs, admin auth guards, CRUD flow, slug uniqueness, blog image upload (JPG success, >10MB reject, .txt reject), admin gallery list/upload/delete, cache invalidation verification, delete key-prefix security guard, and public gallery. All 18 backend tests PASSED. Frontend Playwright tests verified /our-blog rendering (9 articles incl. 1 featured), search filter (8 Years -> 1 match), ServiceNow category filter (-> 2 matches), detail page with title/images/content/next-article nav, 404 'Article Not Found' fallback, legacy /blog route shows 9 posts, /life-at-sgital masonry (32 imgs incl. thumbnails), admin login with webadmin/Sgital2026, all 4 admin tabs render, Blog tab lists 9 posts, New Post opens editor modal with ReactQuill, full UI create-and-delete flow worked, Gallery tab shows dropzone + 17 photo grid. No bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminApplicationsPage.jsx is 728 lines - exceeds 700-line threshold; consider splitting ApplicationsList / ContactsList into their own components for maintainability.

AdminApplicationsPage uses app._id / contact._id as identifiers (lines 573, 582, 591, 697, 706) to call status-update endpoints. Since MongoDB ObjectIds are stripped on the backend (_doc_to_dict excludes _id), _id may be undefined - falling back to index. Verify the applications/contacts endpoints return a stable id (UUID) and the UI uses that instead of _id.
blog.py _display_date_now uses %-d (platform-dependent, Linux-only); fine for container but won't run on Windows dev machines.

admin_gallery.py: DELETE endpoint accepts key via query string - OK with prefix guard, but consider also validating path traversal (e.g. images/life-at-sgital/../other/x.jpg would still pass startswith but S3 normalizes keys literally, so OK).
Consider adding rate-limiting on admin/upload-image since it's authenticated only; large-file rejection is fine (400 at 10MB).
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed data created. Tests cleanup after themselves (CRUD flow deletes created posts; gallery upload test deletes uploaded S3 object).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression test file /app/backend/tests/test_blog_and_gallery.py covers all blog+gallery endpoints. It uses /tmp/life-gallery/*.jpg for upload fixture. Admin creds in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Frontend testids: admin-tab-{applications,contacts,blog,gallery}, blog-admin-{new-btn,post-<slug>,edit-<slug>,delete-<slug>}, blog-editor-{modal,title,slug,category,description,content,image-file,image-btn,published,save,close}, gallery-admin-{dropzone,file-input,photo-<filename>,delete-<filename>}. Post slug 'sgital-marks-8-years' is the seeded featured post. Publish toggle (eye icon) was not explicitly tested via UI but PATCH endpoint which it calls is validated in backend test_create_update_delete_flow.
